risks.title: Risk of NASDAQ delisting (HFCAA)
risks.score_rationale: Major risk located at the beginning of Item 3, very intense language ("materially and adversely affect", "significantly decline or become worthless"). Critical dependence on PCAOB access in mainland China; although situation improved in December 2022, annual recurring risk. High categorical weight: delisting equals destruction of shareholder value.

risks.title: Compliance with CAC Cybersecurity Measures
risks.score_rationale: Risk specific to operations in China, located in key section (Item 3). Cautious but explicit language ("cannot assure you", "could cause disruptions"). Measures entered into force February 2022; Deswell estimates it is not subject but acknowledges regulatory uncertainty. Potential impact: operational disruptions, significant fines.

risks.title: Compliance with Foreign Company Listing Measures (CSRC)
risks.score_rationale: New and specific risk, described in detail (Overseas Listing Trial Measures, March 2023). Language of marked uncertainty ("cannot predict", "may be subject"). Deswell exempted for past listing but future fundraising subject to CSRC approval. Impact: delays, fines, inability to raise funds.

risks.title: Restrictions on Dividends and Fund Transfers from Chinese Subsidiaries
risks.score_rationale: Structural operational risk described in detail (Cash Flows section and Item 3). Explicit language on Chinese legal constraints (mandatory reserves 10%, RMB conversion caps). Historically no dividends from Chinese subsidiaries (3 years). Direct impact on shareholder distribution capacity.

risks.title: Dependence on Obtaining/Renewing Chinese Government Licenses
risks.score_rationale: Direct operational risk for manufacturing activities. Moderate but clear language ("cannot assure you", "may be required"). Deswell currently holds necessary licenses but acknowledges possibility of new requirements. Impact: activity interruption if non-compliance.

risks.title: Risks Related to Foreign Holding Company Structure in China
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental and systemic risk, located at beginning of Item 3. Strong cautionary language ("unique risks", "specifically cautioned", "significant legal and operational risks"). Recent regulatory actions by PRC government on VIE structures and supervision of Chinese companies listed abroad. Uncertainty on impact of new regulations.

risks.title: Inability to Enforce US Judgments Against Deswell
risks.score_rationale: Structural legal risk linked to BVI incorporation. Explicit language ("difficult or impossible", "uncertainty as to enforceability"). No reciprocal arrangement between BVI/Hong Kong and United States. Impact: shareholders/creditors cannot enforce US judgments.

risks.title: Chinese Regulatory Uncertainties on Trading/E-Commerce Activities
risks.score_rationale: Indirect but relevant risk: Deswell conducts trading activities via Macao subsidiaries. Cautious language ("cannot assure you") on interpretation of new regulations (anti-monopoly, cybersecurity). Trend: strengthened regulatory supervision in China.
